features.title: Uvoz recepta sa URL-a
features.current_state: lib/features/recipes/add_recipe_sheet.dart offers existing photo/name/manual inputs; lib/features/recipes/ai_preview.dart:AiRecipePreview already reviews before save. lib/domain/recipe.dart:RecipeSource has only photo/ai/manual; Recipe has no URL/author/extraction provenance. lib/data/recipe_repository.dart:RecipeRepository.create is transactional with outbox.
features.proposed_changes: ImportRequestV1(kind=url, input, clientRequestId) -> ImportDraftV1(recipe candidate, provenance, field evidence, warnings, completeness). Server fetch -> schema.org JSON-LD/microdata -> bounded text extraction -> opt-in AIRouter fallback -> existing preview -> RecipeRepository transaction. Keep author, original URL, final fetched URL and claimed canonical URL distinct; none authorizes another fetch.
scope_slices: Add pure adapter and synthetic HTML fixtures for single Recipe and @graph, returning unsaved drafts.
Add isolated server fetch policy and authenticated endpoint; reject unavailable capability.
Connect existing add/preview/save flow, source metadata and outbox migration; add fallback only after structured import works.
acceptance_criteria: Structured fixture imports with zero AI requests and zero recipe writes before confirmation.
Multiple Recipe entities require explicit selection; absent quantities remain null with review flags.
Discard produces zero recipe/outbox writes; retry with same accepted operation ID creates one recipe.
All redirect/image/canonical-derived requests pass G-SERVER; private target makes zero outbound connections.
verification: Unit fixtures: JSON-LD object/list/@graph, microdata, malformed JSON, HowToSection, ranges and unknown yields.
Fake DNS/HTTP tests: public->private redirect, DNS rebinding, mapped IPv6, oversized/chunked/decompression body and timeout.
Widget save/discard/retry and local two-account RLS/outbox tests after implementation.

features.title: Potvrđeni sinonimi sastojaka i jedinica
features.current_state: lib/domain/shopping_sync.dart:ingredientKey normalizes spelling; lib/domain/shopping_demand.dart:normalizeUnit and demandFor separate mass/volume/count, without household synonym records. lib/domain/supply_allocation.dart:allocateSupply requires equal keys and unit groups.
features.proposed_changes: AliasV1(id, householdId, kind=ingredient|unit, normalizedAlias, canonicalId, confirmedBy, revision, retiredAt). Pure resolver used by search/demand/allocation; ingredients retain display spelling. Unit aliases map labels to an existing dimension and exact factor, never infer density. Suggestions require confirmation; changed aliases preview affected live demands and preserve approved historical snapshots.
scope_slices: Introduce immutable alias resolver with cycle/collision rejection and fixture tests.
Persist confirmed household aliases through repository/outbox and migration; expose review action.
Use one resolver in search/demand/allocation, rebuilding affected live projections transactionally with versioned snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: beli luk/češnjak user-confirmed mapping resolves to one ingredient; unconfirmed suggestion changes nothing.
500 g plus 0.5 kg canonical demand equals 1,000,000,000 micros; g and ml remain separate.
Cycles, ambiguous canonical mappings and cross-household aliases are rejected; retirement does not rewrite history.
verification: Pure tests for Serbian Latin diacritics, whitespace, duplicate/cyclic aliases and dimension mismatch.
Golden demand/allocation before/after alias migration; two-account isolation and outbox replay.

features.title: Sačuvane kombinovane pretrage
features.current_state: lib/domain/recipe_format.dart:filterRecipes searches only normalized title substring; lib/features/recipes/recipe_providers.dart:RecipeSearch holds an ephemeral string; RecipeRepository.watchAll supplies current household recipes.
features.proposed_changes: RecipeQueryV1(text, includeIngredientIds, excludeIngredientIds, maxPrepMinutes, includeUnknownDuration=false, dietaryRuleSetId) plus SavedRecipeQuery(id, owner, name, queryJson, version). Extend current list/provider and pure query engine; persist user data via repository/outbox. Start with local scan, add drift index only when measured. Fuzzy title matches cannot satisfy hard ingredient exclusions.
scope_slices: Implement typed predicates and query serialization over existing Recipe list.
Expose combined filters on existing list; preserve title-search behavior and animations.
Persist, rename and delete saved queries; later add migration-backed index from benchmark evidence.
acceptance_criteria: AND query <=30 min + piletina + exclude kikiriki returns exactly fixture set.
Unknown duration excluded for strict <=30 unless explicitly included; missing metadata shown.
Saved query survives restart/offline/sync and never leaks between accounts.
1,000 recipes/20 ingredients predicate benchmark target p95 <200 ms on declared baseline device, recorded rather than presumed.
verification: Truth-table tests for conjunction/exclusion, unknowns, Serbian spelling and deterministic ordering.
Widget save/load/delete; replay serialization round trip; benchmark without network or AI.

features.title: Mogu danas da skuvam
features.current_state: lib/domain/shopping_demand.dart:demandFor provides scaled micros and unknownGroup; lib/domain/supply_allocation.dart:allocateSupply deduplicates purchase/receipt physical stock. lib/data/pantry_repository.dart:receivePurchases persists receipts; no recipe feasibility ranking API exists.
features.proposed_changes: RecipeFeasibilityV1(recipeId, servings, status=covered|missing|needsReview, remainingLines, allocations, snapshotRevision). Build from existing demandFor/allocateSupply on confirmed usable pantry supplies, considering current reservations. Standalone candidate evaluation uses a fresh copy of the same stock, while accepted multi-slot plans share one allocation ledger. Quantity-free or uncertain lines never imply numerical coverage.
scope_slices: Add pure feasibility façade over existing quantity functions.
Read confirmed stock/reservations through pantry data layer and show covered/missing/review groups.
Connect serving changes and approval refresh against current stock revision.
acceptance_criteria: Recipe requiring 400 g with 250 g confirmed stock shows exactly 150 g missing.
Unknown stock or recipe quantity yields needsReview, never covered.
One purchase and its pantry receipt count once; two 200 g meals cannot both claim the same 250 g in a joint plan.
Missing 1–2 counts distinct demand groups and lists incompatible units separately.
verification: Hand-calculated 400-250=150 g fixture, serving scaling, reservations and receipt canonicalId tests.
Regression existing demand/allocation tests plus offline recipe list/widget update on pantry edits.

features.title: Potroši prvo
features.current_state: lib/data/database.dart:PantryItems.expiresAt/confirmedAt exist. Supply in lib/domain/supply_allocation.dart has no expiration metadata and allocates by supply ID; no expiry-aware ranking is present.
features.proposed_changes: ExpiryEvidence(supplyCanonicalId, confirmedExpiresOn, dateKind, confirmationRevision). Rank candidates by actually allocatable known quantity from eligible soon-expiring lots, through an adapter around existing allocation. Do not change generic allocator ordering silently: introduce explicit lot preference policy after agreement with stream C. Date-only CivilDate and injected today; past date is review/exclude policy, never a safety judgment.
scope_slices: Add pure expiring-lot ranking with fixed today and date-kind handling.
Expose window and confirmed dates on existing pantry-backed suggestions.
Add versioned policy to plan candidate scoring and explanation evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Only confirmed expiry within chosen 3-day window contributes; unknown and expired dates do not earn a bonus.
Bonus capped by quantity actually consumed by candidate; duplicated receipt earns no extra credit.
Identical input and today produce identical order; reasons show the actual item/date.
verification: Fixed-clock tests across month/year boundaries and Europe/Belgrade DST dates.
Competing-lot fixture proving 50 g consumed from 100 g soon-expiring stock earns 50 g evidence, not 100 g.
Widget unknown-date/expired-review and stock-revision refresh tests.

features.title: PDF i nalepljeni tekst
features.current_state: lib/ai/recipe_ai.dart:RecipeAI supports fromImage/fromDishName/refine; lib/features/recipes/from_photo_screen.dart and AiRecipePreview provide image draft flow. No PDF/text import endpoint or source-document model exists.
features.proposed_changes: Reuse ImportDraftV1 with kind=text|pdf, immutable source digest, page/character spans and extraction mode=text|ocr|ai. Proposed limits: 10 MiB PDF, 10 selected pages, 100k extracted characters; enforce byte/magic/type limits and sandbox parser with network disabled. Text first, optional OCR on empty/scanned pages; capability response reports unsupported encrypted PDF/OCR. AI must preserve unresolved quantity strings and flag uncertainty.
scope_slices: Add paste-text pure parser/draft into same preview.
Add bounded PDF text service and page selection; source spans retained.
Add OCR capability adapter for scans with explicit unavailable state and same review/save transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Pasted fixture and text PDF preserve ingredients, source spans and null unknown quantities with no auto-save.
Scanned PDF without OCR reports „Prepoznavanje ovog dokumenta nije dostupno” and offers text/photo input.
Encrypted, overlimit and malformed PDFs fail boundedly; temporary uploads expire within 24 h unless explicitly retained.
verification: Synthetic PDF/text/scanned/encrypted fixtures, page/byte/time cap tests and sandbox no-egress assertion.
Parser mismatch fake-AI tests and preview corrections/discard; no upstream code executed.

features.title: Prevod uz očuvan original
features.current_state: lib/domain/recipe_version.dart:RecipeVersion stores previous recipe; lib/data/recipe_repository.dart:update retains at most 30 historical versions. lib/domain/recipe.dart:toAiJson contains numeric quantities and steps, but no immutable original language/document.
features.proposed_changes: TranslationDraft(sourceRevisionId, targetLocale=sr-Latn, translated text by stable field IDs, numericInvariantDiff). Freeze original in provenance asset, not only the 30-version rolling history. Send text fields and placeholder tokens for quantities/units/times to AIRouter; reconstruct typed numeric fields deterministically. Unit conversions are a separate confirmed operation. Save a normal version with translation link and provenance.
scope_slices: Implement field/token mapping and numeric-invariant validator.
Add AIRouter translation draft and paired original/translation preview.
Persist confirmed version and immutable original reference with delete/restore coverage.
acceptance_criteria: 2.5 g, 180 °C, 1/2 and 20 minutes preserve their original numeric/unit facts, including numbers inside steps.
Any missing/changed placeholder blocks save with a review issue.
After 31 later edits original source remains retrievable; output UI is Serbian Latin.
verification: Fake provider attempts altering numeric tokens, reordered fields and Cyrillic response.
Round-trip source/version restore, prune/delete and private asset access tests.

features.title: Share meni i browser unos
features.current_state: lib/app/router.dart contains in-app routes; existing add_recipe_sheet.dart lacks a share/extension intake contract. Existing repository and preview can own eventual save.
features.proposed_changes: ExternalIntakeV1(kind=url|text|image, payload, intakeId, receivedAt, platform). OS share adapter and optional browser bridge feed existing ImportRequestV1; no separate storage. Persist small pending intake in account-scoped local queue; require sign-in before preview and explicit save. Reject executable schemes and oversize payload; browser extension uses least privilege active tab and never embeds provider credentials.
scope_slices: Define deduplicated intake queue and route adapter with fake platform tests.
Implement capability probe/share intake per supported Android/iOS/macOS target and normal URL fallback.
Evaluate browser extension separately after app share works; consume same schema and endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Same intake delivered twice yields one pending draft; no background recipe save.
Cold/warm start and sign-in handoff preserve payload only within selected account.
Unsupported platform displays „Nalepi link recepta”; URL parser rejects file/javascript/data schemes.
verification: Platform integration matrix for cold/warm app, canceled sign-in, account switch, app restart and invalid deep link.
Fake hostile extension payload and preview discard/idempotent save tests.

features.title: Uvoz objave sa društvene mreže
features.current_state: No social import integration exists in inspected lib/ai/recipe_ai.dart or add_recipe_sheet.dart. RecipeSource cannot express source post/transcript provenance.
features.proposed_changes: SocialImportCapability(platform, supportedMedia, publicUrlOnly, status) delegates URL/text/image material to ImportDraftV1. Record post URL, submitted caption/transcript ownership/source and unavailable sections. Begin user-supplied caption/image rather than promise platform API access. No authenticated scraping, paywall bypass, remote code execution or invention from thumbnail/title; platform adapter returns needsUserContent when insufficient.
scope_slices: Accept supplied post URL plus caption/image through shared draft flow.
Add supported-public-domain capability adapter only after API/terms review.
Add transcript spans when available; retain partial draft and review state.
acceptance_criteria: Title+thumbnail alone produces insufficient evidence, not a full recipe.
Private/deleted/blocked post offers paste/photo path without requesting social credentials.
Every inferred field is marked; confirmation needed before recipe save.
verification: Synthetic public-caption, partial-caption, unavailable-post and prompt-injection fixtures.
Capability-off and timeout widget flows; provenance and no-autosave checks.

features.title: RSS predlozi
features.current_state: No feed entities or subscription scheduler in lib/data/database.dart; RecipeRepository stores only explicitly saved recipes.
features.proposed_changes: FeedSubscriptionV1(id, householdId, url, enabled, etag, lastModified, checkedAt) and FeedEntryV1(feedId, entryKey, title, link, publishedAt, state). Feed entries are suggestions, separate from Recipes. Fetch server-side via G-SERVER, parse bounded RSS/Atom with XML external entities/DTD/network disabled; conditional HTTP, capped poll/backoff and per-household uniqueness. Selecting entry invokes F001 preview.
scope_slices: Implement bounded synthetic RSS/Atom parser and stable entry identity.
Add subscription repository/cache and constrained server polling.
Show suggestions with explicit import preview and unsubscribe/delete lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated fetch/304 produces zero duplicate entries and zero recipe writes.
Unknown/non-date publication time stays unknown; GUID-less stable key uses normalized link and feed scope.
XXE/entity expansion blocked; private enclosure/image/link cannot bypass fetch boundary.
Unsubscribe halts later polling; offline shows last successful check time.
verification: RSS/Atom/namespace fixtures, GUID reuse, 304, bad ETag, redirects, XML bomb and malicious link tests.
Fake clock rate/backoff and unsubscribe; preview/discard/offline widgets and RLS.

features.title: Potroši ove tri namirnice
features.current_state: filterRecipes in lib/domain/recipe_format.dart only searches titles; F004 quantity engine exists at domain level but no session-only ingredient selector.
features.proposed_changes: QuickIngredientIntentV1(selected canonical ingredient IDs, optional quantities/unit, expiresWithSession=true). Feed same RecipeQuery/feasibility/scoring contracts. Name-only entries contribute matched-ingredient reasons, never confirmed availability. No phantom pantry entries or supply IDs; optional quantities are ephemeral scenario supply and clearly distinct from confirmed stock.
scope_slices: Add pure matching by canonical ingredients and evidence type.
Add 1–3 ingredient quick action on existing search flow.
Allow optional quantity scenario and transition to normal plan preview with no pantry writes.
acceptance_criteria: Three selected ingredient names produce ranked matches even with an empty pantry.
Name-only match shows „Sadrži izabrane namirnice”, never „Imaš sve”.
Closing flow leaves pantry/outbox unchanged; duplicate synonyms count once.
verification: Empty-pantry, synonym-duplicate and unknown-quantity tests.
Widget enter/clear/close and verify zero database writes until explicit recipe/plan approval.

features.title: Kontrola ponavljanja
features.current_state: lib/ai/meal_plan_ai.dart:propose only passes already planned draft titles to outline. lib/data/meal_plan_repository.dart:setCooked toggles bool; lib/data/database.dart:MealPlanEntries has isCooked but no actual cookedAt event history.
features.proposed_changes: RepetitionRuleV1(canonicalRecipeId, windowDays, maxOccurrences, mode=hard|prefer) and CookingOccurrence(eventId, entryId?, recipeIdentity, recipeRevision, cookedOn, reversesEventId?). Integrate F047 actual cooking history; existing true flags have unknown actual dates and must not be fabricated from planned dates. Count actual cooking plus accepted prospective slots for planning limits, without counting canceled/undone cooking twice. Tie history to stable recipe identity, not title.
scope_slices: Agree cooking-event contract with stream E and migrate legacy flags as undated evidence.
Add pure rolling-window counter and candidate predicate.
Expose frequency setting and reason; use in offline and AI candidate validation.
acceptance_criteria: One cooking yesterday with max 1/7 days prevents another proposed occurrence; unexecuted old plans do not.
Two recipes sharing a title remain distinct; rename does not erase history.
Unsatisfiable frequency leaves slot unresolved and offers explicit rule edit; no silent relaxation.
verification: Fixed-date 7-day boundary, undo/duplicate event, rename and same-title fixtures.
Legacy isCooked import shows unknown date; fake AI violating frequency rejected.

features.title: Sezonski izbor
features.current_state: No region/season ingredient calendar in lib/domain/recipe.dart or database.dart; mealPlanSystemPrompt broadly mentions Serbian supermarkets but has no seasonal evidence.
features.proposed_changes: SeasonCalendarV1(id, regionCode, publisher, sourceUrl, sourceRevision, license, reviewedAt, monthRanges, canonicalIngredientIds). Start manually curated and independently licensed Serbian region data; no claimed dataset collected in this pass. Seasonal scoring is a soft preference after hard rules, never availability or freshness fact. Preserve date and region of reason; offline uses last reviewed dataset.
scope_slices: Define versioned calendar and pure month-wrap lookup with synthetic data.
Validate a region-specific dataset license/source before shipping real entries.
Add opt-in regional preference, local cache and bounded scoring reason.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture spanning Nov-Feb matches Nov/Jan but not June; unsupported region produces no seasonal bonus.
Reason shows region, month and calendar version/source; missing data produces no invented claim.
Seasonality never outranks a hard exclusion or substitutes for pantry stock.
verification: Synthetic month/hemisphere/region tests and offline cache/version update.
Data review checks licensing, source date, canonical mapping and no unsupported Serbian coverage claim.

features.title: Zašto je ovo predloženo
features.current_state: lib/ai/meal_plan_ai.dart constructs SlotProposal(title, libraryRecipeId/draftRecipeKey); lib/domain/meal_plan.dart:PlanDraft has no score evidence. AIResult.attempts tracks technical attempts, not user recommendation reasons.
features.proposed_changes: RecommendationEvidenceV1(ruleId, inputRevision, metric, value, unit, sourceIds, observedAt) and RecommendationScoreV1(components, rankKey, rulesVersion). Pure scorer emits typed evidence; Serbian formatter renders only present facts. Explain available amount, expiry, duration and cooked history using respective adapters. Technical provider attempts remain separate; model prose cannot become factual evidence.
scope_slices: Add score/evidence value objects and deterministic reason formatter.
Show a reason sheet for F004/F030; enrich with F005/F035/F048 as available.
Persist evidence with draft snapshot and revalidate on approval; show changed-input warning.
acceptance_criteria: 400 g demand/250 g supply reason reports exactly 250 g covered and 150 g missing.
No duration/expiry/history data yields no corresponding statement.
Score order reconstructs exactly from components; stock edit marks evidence stale until refreshed.
Explanations in Serbian Latin show reference date rather than unsupported „sveže” claims.
verification: Hand-computed score golden, absent-field and rule-version tests.
Widget stale evidence/refreshed rank; fake AI cannot inject new reason type or external URL.

features.title: Determinističko novo planiranje offline
features.current_state: lib/features/planning/plan_generation.dart orchestrates MealPlanAI; lib/ai/meal_plan_ai.dart:propose needs network. Existing lib/domain/meal_plan.dart:PlanDraft and MealPlanRepository.approve already support review, snapshots, protected entries and transactional shopping reconciliation.
features.proposed_changes: LocalPlanEngineV1(input: PlanRequest + typed rules + recipe/stock/history snapshots + today + rulesVersion; output: existing PlanDraft plus diagnostics/evidence). Strict candidate filter -> deterministic scorer -> bounded beam search across slots with shared allocateSupply ledger. Stable recipe IDs/slots break ties; no random UUID/time calls in engine. Search caps and deterministic node count provide partial/unsatisfiable diagnostics, not an optimality claim. Existing approve remains sole plan/shopping write path.
scope_slices: Add pure single-slot candidate chooser returning existing SlotProposal/library snapshot.
Extend to chronological multi-slot bounded search with shared stock and protected slots.
Connect offline option to existing preview/approve; add F005/F035/F048 scoring only as each lands.
Benchmark fixed node budget and expose unresolved constraints/unsupported free-text wishes.
acceptance_criteria: Same serialized inputs/rulesVersion yield byte-equivalent normalized draft/evidence in 100 runs regardless recipe insertion order.
All hard rules hold for every filled slot; no solution yields explicit empty slots/reasons, never unsafe fallback.
Single 250 g stock across two 200 g slots records 150 g total shortfall, with no repeated stock allocation.
Network-disabled generation makes zero AI/backend calls and persists nothing until approval.
Target <=2 s for 31 days x3 slots x1,000 candidates with declared node cap/device; if unmet reduce candidate cap transparently without dropping hard rules.
verification: Tiny exhaustive oracle verifies hard constraints and expected ranking; infeasible and locked/cooked replacement cases.
Permutation/property tests for determinism, quantity conservation, unknowns and cancellation/node cap.
Offline widget generation/edit/approve, stale fingerprint and outbox idempotency regression; measured benchmark.
